stories.headline: Divers explore a sunken Silk Road city in Kyrgyzstan
stories.summary: About 20 scientists and volunteer divers are studying a medieval trading city now under Lake Issyk-Kul. It is the first major exploration since the site was rediscovered in the 1800s.
stories.why: The ruins, including two cemeteries, show how people lived along the Silk Road.

stories.stat_label: second-generation planet spotted around a white dwarf
stories.headline: Astronomers find a planet that may have formed from a dead star
stories.summary: A Jupiter-sized planet orbits the white dwarf HS 0209+0832 every 4.4 days. The star is rich in niobium, over 1,000 times the Sun's level, which hints the planet formed after the star died.
stories.why: It shows planets may get a second chance to form around dead stars.

stories.headline: Medicine Nobel goes to the light switch for brain cells
stories.summary: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel won for optogenetics, which uses an algae protein to switch nerve cells on with light. It has already been tried in people to treat a form of blindness.
stories.why: It helps map the brain and may lead to treatments for Parkinson's and epilepsy.

stories.headline: A new saber-toothed predator is named in Argentina
stories.summary: Fossils found on the pampas belong to Pampaluctor calibar, a marsupial relative that lived later than scientists thought its group survived. It was likely an ambush hunter.
stories.why: It shows South America's native predators lasted longer than thought.

fun_fact: Issyk-Kul is one of the largest mountain lakes in the world.
